name: Apprise
short_desc: Push notifications to 100+ services via a simple API.
author: Chris Caron
description: Apprise API lets you send notifications to 100+ services from a lightweight HTTP gateway, with optional persistent configuration keys.

form_fields.label: API Key
form_fields.hint: Secret required as X-API-Key header on /notify, /add, /get, /del, and /cfg paths.

form_fields.label: Stateful Mode
form_fields.hint: How configs are stored: simple (files by key), hash, or disabled.

form_fields.label: Worker Count
form_fields.hint: Gunicorn workers. 1 is enough for light homelab use.
